    Block matrices and cancellation #

    The matrix computations in the proof of Theorem 5.2. Let f : X ⊕ Y → X' ⊕ Y' be an isomorphism, written through binary bicones, with blocks α, β, γ, δ and inverse blocks α', β', γ', δ'. Then (5.1)

    α'α = 1 - β'γ, αα' = 1 - βγ',

    so α is an isomorphism when β'γ and βγ' are nilpotent; and when α is an isomorphism, the Schur complement δ - γα⁻¹β is an isomorphism with inverse δ'. Morphisms compose diagrammatically (f ≫ g is g ∘ f).
